answer: Entry is insured, not staked. (1) Each joiner buys a policy from a bonded underwriter. (2) Collateral scales with pair exposure in that underwriter's book, n(n-1)/2, so 500 puppets on one book need 124,750 pair-units; a lone agent needs 1. (3) Audits draw random pairs, and a pair sharing an operator slashes the underwriter, never the puppet. (4) Refusing correlated books forces the farmer to self-underwrite, locking its own capital in a canyon of collateral. A pearl is priced per oyster, yet an ember that lights a thousand candles is billed for every candle.
